rationale: RELABEL 2026-10-24 (extended vocabulary, Lead-ruled; the svelte precedent): the SFC template component-tag emission is `renders`, not `instantiates` — the host renderer mounts the component and no `new` exists in the source (types.ts Renders contract). This fixture's template-tag pins were converted `instantiates`->`renders` with every other field byte-identical; historical measurement counts inside this rationale still name the label they were measured under. M59 (#825). Lines read off the fixture's own text. The pre-fix values in `forbidRelationships` are MEASURED, not reconstructed: the same fixture was run through the HEAD worktree's analyzer (script/m14/tmp/web-fixture-dump.ts --root=) and every one of its 16 relationships reported no line, while the two prop symbols were stamped line 30 — the `props: { ... }` PAIR — for keys written on 31 and 32. Three separate contracts are pinned: (1) the SFC SEAM — the script block is delegated to the js/ts analyzer, whose lines are script-relative, and the wrapper's merge must shift them (the `import ChildPanel` edge is a file line here: 25, not the delegate's script-relative position); (2) the TEMPLATE — a component usage's line is its TAG (16, 18) and an interpolation read's line is the fragment the name is written in (16, 17, 19); (3) OPTIONS API — a prop's line is its KEY's line (31, 32), never the enclosing `props:` pair's (30). On the corpus the seam defect alone made 562 of 585 line-bearing vue edges INCONSISTENT before it was fixed.
